title: Richard Thompson's Alien Identities on the Hindu devas
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Richard Thompson's Alien Identities on the Hindu devas, about antiquity at India, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Richard Thompson has written a great uh UFO uh book like looking very carefully at Hindu scriptures such as Ramayana and Mahabarata. I think it's called alien identities.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says that a writer named Richard Thompson wrote a careful UFO book, which Jorjani thinks is called Alien Identities, reading ancient Hindu epics such as the Ramayana and the Mahabharata for their accounts of the gods, called devas. He mentions it alongside a man named Michael Cremo and a book called Forbidden Archaeology. If the reading holds, it would mean ancient Indian scripture records contact with non-human beings.
